shortDescription: Add, change, remove or query a tcp/ip interface.

options.name: alias_name
options.description: A name that can be used in place of the internet address. This alias_name can be used to change, remove, start, end and query a internet interface.

options.name: associated_local_interface
options.description: Use this parameter to associate the IPv4 interface being added with an existing local IPv4 TCP/IP interface.

options.name: auto_start
options.description: Specifies whether the interface is automatically started when the TCP/IP stack is activated by the Start TCP/IP (STRTCP) command.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: extra_params
options.description: The extra parameters that the user wants to pass into this module. These are the additional CL parameters that the user wants to pass to execute the CL commands.

options.name: internet_address
options.description: The internet address that will be added, changed, removed or queried. The internet address may be an IPv4 or IPv6 address. An interface is associated with a line description.

options.name: joblog
options.description: The job log of the job executing the task will be returned even rc is zero if it is set to True.

options.name: line_description
options.description: the name of the line description associated with the new interface. The line description must exist before the TCP/IP interface can be added.

options.name: max_transmission_unit
options.description: Specifies the maximum size (in bytes) of IP datagrams that can be transmitted through this interface.

options.name: preferred_interface
options.description: A list of preferred IPv4 interfaces that are to be used with the IPv4 interface being added for proxy Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) agent selection.

options.name: sec_to_wait
options.description: The number of seconds that the module waits after executing the task before returning the information of the internet address. Some tasks such as start and end the interface will need to wait some seconds before it can return the final status. If default zero is used, the returned information could be the intermediate status of starting or ending the interface.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the interface. present means to add, change or query the internet interface. When the internet address does not exist on the IBM i system, present option will create the interface. When the internet address exists on the IBM i system, and only internet_address or alias_name is specified, present option will query the specific interface. options.name: subnet_mask
options.description: Defines the subnet mask which is a bit mask that defines the part of the network where this IPv4 interface attaches.

options.name: text_description
options.description: Specifies text that briefly describes the interface.

options.name: type_of_service
options.description: The type of service specifies how the internet hosts and routers should make trade-offs between throughput, delay, reliability, and cost.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: The virtual LAN identifier of the associated line. This identifies the virtual LAN to which this interface belongs according to IEEE standard 802.1Q. This parameter is only valid for interfaces defined for Ethernet adapters that support the 802.1Q standard. This must be used together with line_description.
